channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jackie Robinson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jackie Robinson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Walt Frazier on Martin Luther King, Jackie Robinson
item.description:
Tommy Beer:Fantastic, poignant quote just now from Clyde Frazier on MLK:

“I think Jackie Robinson put us on the field, but Martin Luther King put us behind the mic, put us in the front office. Made other people look at us from a different perspective.”

Walt Frazier on Martin Luther King, Jackie Robinson, Jan 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @TommyBeer.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jackie Robinson
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Jackie Robinson Day:

“I love that we celebrate this... We do live in a time where it seems like we're trying not to teach history anymore. You can't whitewash history; you have to teach it for us to be a better people.”

Doc Rivers on Jackie Robinson, Apr 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Rich Paul on Jackie Robinson
item.description:
“You’re talking about a game that was once limited. Jackie Robinson and Roberto Clemente – guys like that people didn’t even want to play the game. The Negros had to have their own league to us now owning and representing in that business sector. It’s a testament to us continuing to evolve and not being complacent.”

Rich Paul on Jackie Robinson, Feb 24, 2023. Source: USA Today Sports.
